synopsis.text:
He shares similar interests with Miyoshi—a fellow female otaku—and, best of all, they both love dirty talk. That day, too, she was having a lively, ribald conversation with his male friend Maeda—but the mood shifted the moment he caught sight of a condom that Miyoshi had accidentally dropped. But then, looking a bit shy, Miyoshi suggests, "Wanna use it?" Though taken aback, the two head to a hotel—and soon find themselves hooked on a raw, physical pleasure that a manga simply can't capture!

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)
